pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions are characterized by irregular, polygonal geometries with multi-directional jagged edges. Pixel gradients at patch boundaries are soft. Region size is non-uniform, with large, elongated polygons on the neck transitioning to smaller, more rounded islands on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological web. Intersection nodes typically connect three or four paths. Pathway thickness is relatively consistent across the mid-flank, while continuity is maintained throughout the visible regions of the torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The dorsal mane presents a continuous, dark linear boundary. The profile exhibits low-amplitude, high-frequency jaggedness, appearing as a series of fine, vertical pixel protrusions against the background environment.
